en: Make standalone local paths in chat text and code blocks clickable, including Windows paths with spaces and Chinese characters. Folder links open File Explorer.
Add native application and folder actions for local files, including videos and formats without an inline preview. Executables and scripts are shown in their folder instead of being run.
Recognize file links with line-number fragments and report native opening errors.
zh: 聊天正文和代码框中独立成行的本地路径支持点击，兼容含空格、中文的 Windows 路径；文件夹链接直接打开资源管理器。
本地文件增加本机应用打开和文件夹定位入口，视频及无法内嵌预览的格式也可使用；可执行文件和脚本只在文件夹中显示。
识别带行号片段的文件链接，并显示本机打开失败的具体原因。
